card.name: Start of brand names after Z
card.fires_on: The first piece of an uppercase drug brand or generic name, most often a capital Z that begins a name like ZEPATIER or ZTALMY, in drug-label text. Also fires on a lowercase l restarting lumacaftor after a slash.
